verdict: Lead volume is sliding and cost per lead rose sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 151 leads at an average cost of $14.03 per lead, but the most recent 7 days show a 27% drop in leads with cost per lead climbing 35% — both moving in the wrong direction. The single active campaign, running since August, is showing clear signs of audience fatigue: the same spend is returning fewer leads each week. Ad creative is being refreshed to interrupt that decline. A lead tracking gap between your ad platform and your CRM is also being closed, and you can expect cleaner intake numbers once that is resolved.
